## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [彭際清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BD%AD%E9%9A%9B%E6%B8%85) Péng Jìqīng (1740–1796), the principal late-Qīng lay-Buddhist intellectual, is a doctrinal treatise resolving doubts about the *yī chéng* 一乘 (One-Vehicle) doctrine — the foundational Mahāyāna teaching elaborated in the *Avataṃsaka* and the *Lotus*, and the doctrinal centre of the Huáyán-school's distinctive doxographical claim. The *jué yí* "resolving doubts" format is one of the standard Buddhist apologetic genres.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1770 – 1796) reflects Péng's mature Buddhist activity, leading up to his death. The work belongs to his synthesis of Huáyán doctrine and Pure Land devotional practice — alongside *[Huáyán niàn fó sānmèi lùn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0148)* (X1030) — that became the foundational corpus of late-Qīng / early-Republican lay-Buddhist intellectualism.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1029) collection.
